description:
Remove the provenance-only embedded profile origin that remains after compiled profile packages and their resolver were removed, so applied profile records have one resolvable repository-directory origin.

## Background

Issue `ff1bbada` removed profile packages compiled into the executable, their presets, and every production resolution path for an embedded package. Later ownership-record work reintroduced `ProfileOrigin::Embedded`, an `EmbeddedProvenanceUnavailable` error, and command bypasses that tolerate such a record without providing a package source. The epic's final holistic review found that this dead representation contradicts the canonical-cutover contract and makes a serialized origin promise that no lifecycle command can fulfill. The owner selected repository-directory packages as the sole package-source contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The current applied-profile wire model and generated schema expose only a worktree-relative directory origin; a record containing `source: "embedded"` is rejected by normal strict decoding, and human and JSON output expose no embedded profile-origin option.
- [hard] REQ-02: Profile command planning, ownership lookup, mutation eligibility, and recorded-package resolution contain no embedded-provenance error, provenance-only exclusion scan, bypass, or special branch. Every applied record resolves through the canonical repository-directory package route, whose existing behavior remains unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: Existing ownership, aggregate planning, initialization, capture, reconfiguration, and upgrade tests use directory-origin fixtures without weakening their semantic assertions. The generated CLI schema and MCP schema-derived inventory contain no embedded profile-origin value.
- [hard] REQ-04: The existing semantic lifecycle cutover guard is extended to reject reintroduction of a compiled profile package source, embedded profile origin or wire tag, embedded-only resolver error, or resolver bypass in production and generated schema, with adversarial self-tests that prove actionable diagnostics rather than relying only on exact symbol names.
- [hard] REQ-05: The cutover adds no migration decoder, compatibility adapter, record rewrite, fallback package, or second resolver. A pre-release record with an unsupported origin fails through the ordinary strict wire boundary; a repository that needs to adopt current provenance re-derives its package through capture as specified by the epic.

## Notes

The unrelated archive-plan use of the word `Embedded` describes bytes stored inside an archive plan and is not a profile package source. It is outside this task.
title: Remove unsupported embedded profile provenance
